# Relics Guide — Tang and Song Dynasty
> Honest travel guide to surviving Tang and Song dynasty architecture in China. Every site carries an authenticity label.

## Primary Page

### Homepage
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/
Comprehensive guide comparing Tang vs Song dynasties: what survives today, where to visit, authenticity labels, travel routes, museums, and FAQ.

## Tang Dynasty Sites

### Foguang Temple East Hall
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/foguang/
Largest Tang wooden structure (857 AD). Complete travel guide: transport, accommodation, food, best season, tips for foreign travelers.

### Nanchan Temple
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/nanchan/
Oldest wooden building in China (782 AD). Complete travel guide with practical tips.

### Big Wild Goose Pagoda
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/dayanta/
Xi'an landmark built 652 AD (Ming rebuild on Tang foundation). Complete travel guide.

### Mogao Caves
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/mogao/
200+ Tang cave temples in Dunhuang, largest surviving body of Tang pictorial art. UNESCO. Complete travel guide.

### Famen Temple Museum
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/famen/
Greatest Tang archaeological find with 2,499 Tang artifacts discovered in 1987. Complete travel guide.

### Daming Palace National Heritage Park
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/daming/
Main Tang imperial palace, larger than the Forbidden City. Archaeological site. Complete travel guide.

### Great Tang All Day Mall
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/datangbuye/
2010 theme park in Xi'an with Tang-style lighting. Modern reconstruction. Complete travel guide.

## Song Dynasty Sites

### Baoguo Temple Main Hall
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/baoguo/
Oldest wooden structure in southern China (1013 AD), Ningbo. Complete travel guide.

### Tiger Hill Pagoda
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/huqiu/
Leaning pagoda in Suzhou (961 AD) predating Pisa by 200 years. Complete travel guide.

### Kaifeng Iron Pagoda
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/kaifengtieta/
Only above-ground Song structure in Kaifeng (1049 AD). Complete travel guide.

### Jinci Temple Hall of Holy Mother
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/jinci/
Earliest surviving major Song timber hall (1032 AD), Taiyuan. Complete travel guide.

### Longxing Temple
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/longxing/
Four original Song buildings and a 21.3m bronze Guanyin (971 AD), Zhengding. Complete travel guide.

### Qingming Riverside Landscape Garden
https://www.tang-and-song-dynasty.com/sites/qingmingheyuan/
1998 Song dynasty theme park in Kaifeng. Modern reconstruction. Complete travel guide.
